_meta.concept: Static physical configuration of the speaker. How gravity, skeletal alignment, and thoracic compression alter the vocal tract and diaphragm.
_meta.annotation_instruction: Focus only on acoustic evidence of where the body is relative to gravity.

supine_flat.name: Lying Flat on Back (Supine)
supine_flat.acoustic_signature: The "puddled" voice. Fluid redistribution causes mild nasal congestion. The tongue falls back, slightly dampening high frequencies. Energy is low; projection is poor because the diaphragm fights gravity to lift the viscera.

prone_stomach.name: Lying on Stomach (Prone)
prone_stomach.acoustic_signature: The "pressed" voice. The physical weight of the body crushes the rib cage against the floor. Inhalations are shorter and slightly labored. The voice sounds closer to the ground, with less chest resonance.

side_lying_fetal.name: Curled on Side (Fetal Position)
side_lying_fetal.acoustic_signature: The "cozy" voice. One lung is restricted by the floor, the other is open. Breath is quiet and intimate. Soft, low-volume, with minimal dynamic range.

supine_head_hang.name: Supine with Head Hanging (Hyperextended)
supine_head_hang.acoustic_signature: The "stretched" voice. The neck is arched backward over an edge. The skin of the throat is tight, raising the pitch slightly and thinning the tone. Swallowing is audible and difficult.

propped_elbows.name: Lying Prone Propped on Elbows
propped_elbows.acoustic_signature: Similar to prone, but the upper chest is open. Abdominal compression (stomach pressed into floor) but clearer projection than being fully flat.

sitting_slouched.name: Deep Recline / Slouching
sitting_slouched.acoustic_signature: The "mushy" voice. The spine is C-shaped, collapsing the diaphragm. Articulation is lazy; the jaw barely moves. The voice lacks drive or attack.

sitting_neutral.name: Upright Chair (Office/Table)
sitting_neutral.acoustic_signature: The "standard" voice. Balanced resonance. Breath support is stable but lacks the full power of standing. Neutral acoustic baseline.

sitting_perched.name: Perched on Edge/Stool
sitting_perched.acoustic_signature: The "alert" sitter. Core muscles engaged to maintain balance. Voice slightly more energized and tighter than neutral sitting.

sitting_cross_legged.name: Floor Sitting (Lotus/Cross-legged)
sitting_cross_legged.acoustic_signature: The "grounded" voice. Spine usually straight, hips tight. Slight bracing in the voice, resonance implies mouth closer to reflective surfaces.

sitting_lean_forward.name: Elbows on Knees (The Brooder)
sitting_lean_forward.acoustic_signature: The "compressed" voice. Chest cavity physically made smaller. Voice often directed downward, sounding darker and more introspective. Breath is shallow.

driving_recline.name: Driver's Seat (Reclined + Arms Forward)
driving_recline.acoustic_signature: Blend of relaxed torso with arm tension from holding wheel. Often louder projection to overcome cabin noise, but with sitting breath capacity.

standing_neutral.name: Standing Neutral
standing_neutral.acoustic_signature: The "open" voice. Maximum lung capacity. Clear, resonant, and effortless. Reference point for zero acoustic impedance.

standing_military.name: Rigid Attention (Military)
standing_military.acoustic_signature: The "hard" voice. Chest puffed out; neck muscles tense. Tension transfers to larynx, making voice metallic, barked, or overly projected.

standing_lean_wall.name: Leaning Against Wall
standing_lean_wall.acoustic_signature: The "cool" voice. Slight phase cancellation or bass boost from wall reflection behind head. Vertical but relaxed/asymmetrical.

standing_one_leg.name: Shifted Weight (Hip Cocked)
standing_one_leg.acoustic_signature: Asymmetrical stance. Often correlates with casual or sassy tone. Vertical but lacks rigid drive of neutral stance.

standing_hands_hips.name: Power Pose (Hands on Hips)
standing_hands_hips.acoustic_signature: The "dominant" voice. Elbows out, mechanically locking rib cage expanded. Voice naturally louder and more commanding.

head_chin_up.name: Looking Up (Chin High)
head_chin_up.acoustic_signature: The "thinned" voice. Trachea stretched. Larynx pulled upward, shortening the vocal tract. Voice sounds lighter, tighter, higher-pitched.

head_chin_down.name: Looking Down (Chin to Chest)
head_chin_down.acoustic_signature: The "gravel" voice. Larynx compressed; double chin effect dampens sound. Voice becomes creaky, bass-heavy, and mumbled.

head_turned_side.name: Twisted Neck (Looking over Shoulder)
head_turned_side.acoustic_signature: Torsion in neck muscles restricts larynx on one side. Phonation sounds slightly strained or squeezed.

head_rest_hand.name: Head Resting on Hand
head_rest_hand.acoustic_signature: The "smushed" face. Palm pushes one cheek up, distorting mouth shape. Bilabial sounds are clumsy. Voice sounds bored or tired.

crouching_hiding.name: Crouching / Huddled Ball
crouching_hiding.acoustic_signature: The "small" voice. Knees against chest; maximum compression. Breathing rapid and shallow. Voice hushed, anxious, acoustically boxed in.

bending_waist.name: Bent Over (Touching Toes)
bending_waist.acoustic_signature: The "rush" voice. Blood rushes to head; diaphragm crushed. Voice sounds congested, thick, and strained.

squatting_deep.name: Deep Squat
squatting_deep.acoustic_signature: The "valsalva" voice. High abdominal pressure for core stability. Grunting glottal closure and strained, pushed tone.

kneeling_upright.name: Kneeling (Prayer/Begging)
kneeling_upright.acoustic_signature: Similar to standing but less grounding. Acoustically open in chest. Often correlates with submissive or pleading tone.

inverted_upside_down.name: Inverted (Handstand/Hanging)
inverted_upside_down.acoustic_signature: The "gargle." Gravity reverses blood flow. Vocal folds engorge, making voice extremely thick, wet, and difficult to control.

squeezed_tight_space.name: Confined Space (Crawling/Box)
squeezed_tight_space.acoustic_signature: The "claustrophobic" voice. Shoulders hunched to ears, shortening neck. Tight, tense sound. Very short acoustic reflections.

arms_overhead.name: Arms Reaching Up
arms_overhead.acoustic_signature: The "pulled" voice. Rib cage stretched to limit. Difficult to inhale deeply. Voice thin, lacking lower resonance.

twisted_torso.name: Torso Twist (Yoga/Reaching Back)
twisted_torso.acoustic_signature: Uneven lung expansion. Breath control erratic/wobbly. Effort of twist audible in vowel stability.

slumped_exhausted.name: Post-Exertion Collapse
slumped_exhausted.acoustic_signature: The "breathless" slump. Heavy uncontrolled breathing overpowers speech. Body limp, voice has zero tension.

limp_faint.name: Semi-Conscious / Fainting
limp_faint.acoustic_signature: The "fade." Vocal cord closure weak (breathy/whispery). Volume trails off at end of sentences.

choked_restrained.name: Physically Restrained / Choked
choked_restrained.acoustic_signature: The "strangled" voice. External pressure on neck or chest. Airflow turbulent and raspy. Pitch erratic.

crushed_weight.name: Pinned Under Weight
crushed_weight.acoustic_signature: The "forced" exhale. Cannot inhale freely. Short panicked syllables squeezed out against resistance.

_meta.concept: How metabolic demand, physical movement, and interaction with objects compete with the speech signal.
_meta.annotation_instruction: Based on acoustic evidence only - specific breath patterns, rhythmic interference, or handling noise.

eating_crunchy.name: Eating (Crunchy/Hard)
eating_crunchy.acoustic_signature: Sharp high-frequency transients (snaps, crunches) >2kHz. Irregular pauses for swallowing. Tempo slows to mitigate choking risk.

eating_soft.name: Eating (Soft/Bolus)
eating_soft.acoustic_signature: The "full mouth" resonance. Tongue occupied with food bolus, causing wet smacking and dampened lingual consonants. Vowels sound wider.

drinking_gulping.name: Drinking / Gulping
drinking_gulping.acoustic_signature: The "Fluid Sequence": speech stops, liquid slosh, heavy wet glottal closure gulp, wet release exhalation, speech resumes.

brushing_teeth.name: Dental Hygiene (Brushing)
brushing_teeth.acoustic_signature: Extreme articulation distortion. Jaw held open, destroying labial consonants. Constant background scrubbing noise and foaming saliva.

smoking_vaping.name: Smoking / Vaping
smoking_vaping.acoustic_signature: The "Drag Cycle": audible inhalation with crackle, silence for breath hold, speech during exhalation creating turbulent friction under the voice.

yawning_stretching.name: Yawning
yawning_stretching.acoustic_signature: The "Pharyngeal Slide." Pharynx expands to maximum, voice pitch slides dramatically downward. Articulation becomes hollow and rounded.

typing_keyboard.name: Typing (Standard/Office)
typing_keyboard.acoustic_signature: Fast rhythmic rain of plastic clicks. "Cognitive Load Pacing": as typing speed increases, speech rate slows or fragments.

gaming_intense.name: Gaming (Controller/Mouse)
gaming_intense.acoustic_signature: Louder, more mechanical bursty clicks. Chair squeaks, sudden volume shifts, rapid-fire adrenaline-fueled speech patterns.

writing_manual.name: Writing / Drawing
writing_manual.acoustic_signature: Quiet continuous scritch-scratch friction. Head often angled down causing slight muffling. Pacing slow and synchronized with hand movement.

scrolling_phone.name: Phone Use / Scrolling
scrolling_phone.acoustic_signature: "Acoustic Shadow." Voice directed downward. Quiet thumb-taps. High frequency of distracted fillers while visual attention is occupied.

cleaning_scrubbing.name: Cleaning / Scrubbing
cleaning_scrubbing.acoustic_signature: Rhythmic repetitive friction sounds. Breath often synchronizes with arm movement.

cooking_active.name: Cooking / Kitchen Work
cooking_active.acoustic_signature: Complex soundscape of sizzling, chopping, clattering. Lombard Effect: speaker projects louder to compete with kitchen noise.

dishwashing.name: Dishwashing / Water Handling
dishwashing.acoustic_signature: Constant white noise floor of running water. Sharp clinks of glass and ceramics. Voice loud but distant.

rummaging_bag.name: Rummaging / Searching
rummaging_bag.acoustic_signature: Heavy fabric rustling, zipper zips, plastic crinkles. Speech shifts to object-search mode with mumbling and distracted tempo.

handling_paper.name: Sorting Papers
handling_paper.acoustic_signature: Dry sliding shuffling and sharp paper snaps. Voice often drops to whisper or mumble while reading.

knitting_sewing.name: Knitting / Needlework
knitting_sewing.acoustic_signature: Very quiet rhythmic metallic click-click. Breathing usually very calm and steady, meditative state.

tool_use_manual.name: Using Tools (Hammer/Wrench)
tool_use_manual.acoustic_signature: Heavy rhythmic impacts or metallic ratcheting. Effort grunts at moment of torque or impact interrupt speech.

dressing_undressing.name: Dressing
dressing_undressing.acoustic_signature: Heavy fabric swooshing that may cover mouth temporarily. Compression grunts from bending over for shoes/pants.

holding_baby.name: Holding / Rocking Infant
holding_baby.acoustic_signature: Rhythmic physical bounce in voice from rocking. Tone hushed. One side of chest often compressed.

strolling_leisure.name: Slow Walk (Strolling)
strolling_leisure.acoustic_signature: Gentle relaxed lilt or bobbing in voice pitch (~1Hz). Footsteps barely audible. Breathing slightly deeper than sitting but controlled.

walking_power.name: Power Walking
walking_power.acoustic_signature: The "Pump." Physical impact of heel-strike creates micro-tremor in voice. Inhalations become audible and rhythmic every 4-6 words.

walking_gravel.name: Walking on Noisy Surface
walking_gravel.acoustic_signature: Loud crunching footsteps compete with speech. Speaker raises volume and articulates more clearly.

climbing_stairs.name: Climbing Stairs
climbing_stairs.acoustic_signature: The "Ascension." Progressive breathlessness. Pitch tends to rise with effort. Sentences chopped into 2-3 word chunks.

hiking_uphill.name: Hiking (Steep Incline)
hiking_uphill.acoustic_signature: The "Labor." Heavy deep full-lung breathing. Long pauses between short phrases. Voice has puffed quality.

jogging_steady.name: Jogging / Running
jogging_steady.acoustic_signature: The "Jogger's Tremolo." Voice shakes in sync with step cadence. Breathing machine-like and rhythmic, cannot be interrupted for speech.

sprinting_max.name: Sprinting / Fleeing
sprinting_max.acoustic_signature: Communication Breakdown. Only single syllables or short shouts between violent loud gasps. Voice raw, panicked, unmodulated.

lifting_heavy.name: Heavy Lifting (Static Load)
lifting_heavy.acoustic_signature: The "Valsalva Maneuver." Breath held to brace core, then strangled vocalization under pressure, ending with explosive breath release.

fighting_struggle.name: Fighting / Physical Struggle
fighting_struggle.acoustic_signature: The "Chaos." Sharp sudden impacts. Grunts of pain or exertion. Breath erratic and jagged. Voice aggressive, barking, or screaming.

swimming_surface.name: Swimming (Head Out)
swimming_surface.acoustic_signature: Distinct wet acoustic environment. Speaker gulps air quickly. Speech accompanied by hollow shimmering reverb of water surface.

shivering_cold.name: Shivering / Freezing
shivering_cold.acoustic_signature: The "Chatter." Involuntary vocal tremolo (~8-10Hz) from core muscle spasms. Jaw tense/locked. Speaker hisses through clenched teeth.

crying_sobbing.name: Crying / Sobbing
crying_sobbing.acoustic_signature: The "Inspiratory Spasm." Inhalation jerky like reverse hiccup. Pharynx wet/mucousy. Pitch cracks frequently. Vowels wavering.

laughing_fit.name: Laughing Fit
laughing_fit.acoustic_signature: The "Wheeze." Total inability to articulate due to rapid exhalation spasms. High-pitched squeaks or silence where speaker runs out of air.

stifling_hold.name: Stifling (Holding Back)
stifling_hold.acoustic_signature: The "Leak." Glottis clamped shut, voice high-pitched, squeaky, leaking out under extreme pressure.

whispering_quiet.name: Whispering
whispering_quiet.acoustic_signature: Aphonation. No vocal cord vibration. Speech shaped entirely by air turbulence. High frequencies emphasized; low frequencies absent.

kissing_intimate.name: Kissing / Intimacy
kissing_intimate.acoustic_signature: Smacking wet lip sounds. Extremely close proximity (bass boost). Breath soft, slow, interspersed with soft moans.

vomiting_gagging.name: Gagging / Nausea
vomiting_gagging.acoustic_signature: The "Heave." Retching sounds. Speech garbled, watery, interrupted by involuntary stomach contraction. Voice thick with mucus.

orgasm_sexual.name: Sexual Climax
orgasm_sexual.acoustic_signature: Involuntary vocalization. Rhythmic breathing becomes spasmodic. Pitch rises sharply. Loss of articulation control, replaced by moans and gasps.

coughing_fit.name: Coughing
coughing_fit.acoustic_signature: Explosive percussive blasts of air. Voice immediately following is raspy or wet until cords clear.

sneezing_recovery.name: Sneezing
sneezing_recovery.acoustic_signature: Build-up (sharp intake), explosion, recovery (nasal congested speech due to mucosal swelling).

hiccuping_spasm.name: Hiccuping
hiccuping_spasm.acoustic_signature: Sharp high-pitched intake from diaphragm spasm cuts words in half.

burping_belching.name: Burping
burping_belching.acoustic_signature: Deep guttural vibration from esophagus. Voice momentarily drops into ultra-low monster vocal fry.

driving_active.name: Driving (Active Traffic)
driving_active.acoustic_signature: Background engine hum and turn signal clicks. Focus pauses when navigating, head-turn voice drops.

riding_turbulence.name: Vehicle Turbulence / Bumpy Road
riding_turbulence.acoustic_signature: The "Shimmer." Voice wavers or vibrates rapidly from vehicle shaking. Like artificial vibrato the speaker cannot control.

shaving_electric.name: Shaving (Electric Razor)
shaving_electric.acoustic_signature: Constant mechanical buzz. Speaker distorts cheek/lip to flatten skin, changing vowel shapes.

cycling_intense.name: Intense Cycling / Spinning
cycling_intense.acoustic_signature: The "pedal pulse." Breathing is deep, rhythmic, and locked to the cadence of the legs. Unlike running, there is no vertical impact bounce in the voice — instead a steady, pressured airstream. The saddle compresses the pelvis, slightly tightening the lower abdomen. Speech comes in short bursts timed to exhalation phases. At high intensity, the voice becomes a forced whisper between gasps.

rowing_pulling.name: Rowing / Pulling Heavy Resistance
rowing_pulling.acoustic_signature: The "drive-and-recover." A binary rhythm: explosive grunt on the pull stroke (glottis slams shut for core bracing), then a rushed, breathy phrase during the recovery slide. The body rocks forward and backward, creating a Doppler-like pitch wobble. Sweat and grip strain add tension to the jaw.

climbing_rope_rock.name: Rock Climbing / Rope Climbing
climbing_rope_rock.acoustic_signature: The "cling." Arms overhead and weight on fingertips. The rib cage is stretched and exposed, but the core is locked tight for stability. Speech is whispered or staccato — the speaker cannot waste a single breath on projection. Fear of falling adds a tremor. Head is often tilted upward (chin-up vocal tract geometry).

dancing_vigorous.name: Vigorous Dancing / Rave
dancing_vigorous.acoustic_signature: The "bounce." Full-body rhythmic movement creates a fast, regular tremolo in the voice synced to the beat. Breathing is elevated but often masked by adrenaline and music. The speaker shouts to be heard over the music (extreme Lombard effect). Laughter and exclamations punctuate the gaps between dance moves.

swimming_laps.name: Swimming Laps (Endurance)
swimming_laps.acoustic_signature: The "gasp window." Speech is only possible during the brief head-turn to breathe. Words are expelled in 1-2 syllable bursts between strokes. Water in the mouth and nose creates gurgling and sputtering. The voice is urgent, clipped, and has a wet, hollow quality from the pool acoustic environment.

carrying_load_march.name: Carrying Heavy Load / Forced March
carrying_load_march.acoustic_signature: The "grind." A constant low-grade Valsalva — the core is braced to support the weight, restricting the diaphragm. Breathing is shallow and rapid. Speech has a strained, pushed quality. Footsteps are heavy and thudding. Over time, the voice progressively weakens as fatigue accumulates. Grunting on every step at extreme loads.

digging_shoveling.name: Digging / Shoveling Earth
digging_shoveling.acoustic_signature: The "heave-ho." Rhythmic, percussive effort grunts synced to the shovel strike. The torso bends and straightens cyclically, alternately compressing and expanding the chest. Dirt and gravel sounds punctuate the background. Speech is choppy, timed to the brief upright recovery between digs.

chopping_wood.name: Chopping Wood / Axe Work
chopping_wood.acoustic_signature: The "split." A sharp, explosive grunt at the moment of impact, followed by the crack of splitting wood. Speech only occurs during the wind-up or between swings. Arms-overhead position stretches the rib cage. The voice has a raw, outdoorsy, unmasked quality — zero social filtering.

jumping_plyometric.name: Jumping / Plyometric Exercise
jumping_plyometric.acoustic_signature: The "launch." A sharp exhalation or "hup!" on every takeoff, followed by a thud on landing. The voice jolts violently on each impact. Speaking during jump sequences is nearly impossible — words are fragmented into single syllables launched mid-air and cut off on landing.

martial_arts_sparring.name: Martial Arts / Contact Sparring
martial_arts_sparring.acoustic_signature: The "kiai." Sharp, explosive shouts timed to strikes — these are functional (bracing the core) not decorative. Between exchanges, breathing is controlled and predatory. The voice switches between feral intensity during engagement and calm, measured breathing during circling. Impact sounds of body hits and mat slaps.

yoga_power_hold.name: Power Yoga / Intense Hold Poses
yoga_power_hold.acoustic_signature: The "tremor hold." Muscles shaking under isometric load creates a visible vibrato in the voice. Breathing is deliberately controlled (ujjayi breath — audible oceanic friction in the throat). Speech is slow, strained, and often directed inward. The instructor's cue to "breathe" is ironic — the speaker can barely manage it.

treading_water.name: Treading Water / Staying Afloat
treading_water.acoustic_signature: The "bob." The mouth intermittently dips below the waterline, creating a rhythmic alternation between clear speech and gurgling. Breathing is panicked and gulping if fatigued. Splashing water noise competes with the voice. Arms are occupied, so the speaker cannot gesture — all expression is purely vocal.

foreplay_arousal.name: Foreplay / Arousal Building
foreplay_arousal.acoustic_signature: The "slow burn." Breathing gradually deepens and slows. The voice drops in pitch and becomes increasingly breathy and soft. Whispered words alternate with sighs and soft moans. Wet mouth sounds (kissing, licking) punctuate the speech. Articulation loosens as cognitive focus shifts from language to sensation.

intercourse_active.name: Active Sexual Intercourse (Exerting Partner)
intercourse_active.acoustic_signature: The "thrust rhythm." Breathing becomes heavy, rhythmic, and locked to physical movement. Speech fragments into single words or short commands. Effort grunts sync with exertion. The voice oscillates between breathy whispers (intimate) and involuntary vocalizations (primal). Bed springs, skin contact, and movement noise in background.

intercourse_receptive.name: Receptive Sexual Intercourse (Receiving Partner)
intercourse_receptive.acoustic_signature: The "wave." Vocalizations are primarily reactive — moans, gasps, and cries that rise and fall with stimulation intensity. Breathing is irregular and punctuated by held breath at peaks of pleasure. The voice may crack into higher registers involuntarily. Speech, when attempted, is fragmentary and loses syntactic structure.

oral_sex_giving.name: Giving Oral Sex (Mouth Occupied)
oral_sex_giving.acoustic_signature: The "hum." The mouth is physically occupied, making articulation impossible. Vocalizations are limited to nasal moans, humming, and throat sounds. Breathing is restricted to nasal passages. If the speaker attempts words, they are extremely muffled and distorted. Wet, slurping sounds are prominent.

oral_sex_receiving.name: Receiving Oral Sex
oral_sex_receiving.acoustic_signature: The "unravel." The mouth is free but the brain is overwhelmed by sensation. Speech degrades from coherent sentences to fragments to pure vocalization. Breathing is irregular with sharp intakes. The pitch rises progressively. Moans have a melodic, sustained quality. The speaker may grip surfaces, creating incidental sounds.

moaning_sustained.name: Sustained Pleasure Vocalization / Moaning
moaning_sustained.acoustic_signature: The "aria." Extended, semi-musical vocalizations on open vowels ("ah," "oh"). Pitch contours rise and fall with pleasure waves. The glottis alternates between full phonation (moans) and breathy phonation (sighs). Volume builds with intensity. These are partially involuntary — the speaker cannot fully suppress them.

bondage_restrained_consensual.name: Physical Restraint / Bondage (Consensual)
bondage_restrained_consensual.acoustic_signature: The "strain." Movement is restricted, creating frustrated physical tension that transfers to the voice. Breathing is elevated from arousal and mild panic. Speech may be muffled by a gag (if present) or strained against bindings. The voice sounds vulnerable, exposed, and stripped of physical agency. Rope creak or chain clink in background.

impact_play_receiving.name: Impact Play / Spanking (Receiving)
impact_play_receiving.acoustic_signature: The "sting." Sharp, involuntary yelps or gasps at the moment of impact, followed by a recovery moan that transitions from pain to pleasure. Breathing is anticipatory — held breath before the strike, explosive release after. The voice pitch spikes on impact then settles. Counting or verbal acknowledgment may be required by the dynamic.

breath_play.name: Breath Play / Choking (Consensual)
breath_play.acoustic_signature: The "squeeze." Progressively restricted airflow. The voice thins, rises in pitch, and becomes raspy as pressure increases on the throat. Phonation becomes turbulent — a wet, crackling quality. On release, a loud gasp followed by euphoric, dizzy-sounding speech. Extremely dangerous — the acoustic signature is unmistakable.

edging_orgasm_denial.name: Edging / Orgasm Denial
edging_orgasm_denial.acoustic_signature: The "cliff." Vocalizations build toward a crescendo (increasing pitch, volume, and tempo) then are abruptly forced back down. The speaker makes frustrated, whimpering sounds during denial. Breathing is jagged and unsatisfied. Multiple build-and-stop cycles create increasingly desperate, pleading vocal quality. Speech dissolves into begging.

masturbation_solo.name: Solo Masturbation
masturbation_solo.acoustic_signature: The "private." Vocalizations are typically suppressed or minimal — soft breathing, quiet moans, occasional whispered fantasy narration. The speaker may hold their breath during peaks. If vocalizing freely, the sounds are unselfconscious and raw. No audience awareness — purely involuntary vocal responses to self-stimulation.

post_coital_afterglow.name: Post-Coital Afterglow
post_coital_afterglow.acoustic_signature: The "dissolve." Extreme vocal fry and minimal effort. Breathing is slowly returning to baseline but still elevated. The voice is warm, intimate, and completely unguarded. Endorphins create a dreamy, languid quality. Speech is slow, content, and punctuated by satisfied sighs. Muscle relaxation removes all tension from the throat.

multiple_orgasm.name: Multiple / Successive Orgasms
multiple_orgasm.acoustic_signature: The "cascade." Each climax produces a peak vocalization (scream, moan, or silent apnea), followed by a brief recovery of shaky, overwhelmed breathing, before the next wave hits. The voice becomes progressively more destroyed — hoarse, cracking, and uncontrolled. By the third or fourth, speech is completely impossible.
