target_self_mumble.name: Soliloquy / Self-Talk
target_self_mumble.acoustic_signature: Low volume, lazy articulation, swallowed consonants. Narrow pitch range. Sentences trail off without finishing.

target_internal_monologue.name: Internal Monologue (Thinking Aloud)
target_internal_monologue.acoustic_signature: The "Processing" tone. Slow pacing with irregular pauses. Searching quality with elongated vowels, lacks projection.

target_void_scream.name: Screaming into the Void
target_void_scream.acoustic_signature: Maximum volume but no communicative intent. Raw, often lacking distinct words. Pure cathartic release.

target_divine_prayer.name: Prayer / Divine
target_divine_prayer.acoustic_signature: Hushed, reverent, or chanting quality. Highly regular or melodic rhythm. Lacks conversational fluctuations.

target_intimate_lover.name: Intimate / Lover
target_intimate_lover.acoustic_signature: Proximity Effect dominant: extremely close, boosting bass. Phonation breathy or creaky. Soft consonants. Implies exclusivity.

target_confidential_secret.name: Confidential / Conspirator
target_confidential_secret.acoustic_signature: The "Side-Mouth." Hushed but hyper-precise articulation for clarity without being overheard. Monotonous pitch.

target_conversational_peer.name: Conversational (Peer/Friend)
target_conversational_peer.acoustic_signature: Neutral baseline. Moderate volume, relaxed turn-taking. Contractions used. Rising intonation for turn signals.

target_confrontational_face.name: Confrontational (In-Your-Face)
target_confrontational_face.acoustic_signature: High intensity, hard glottal attacks. Loud but dry (little reverb), implying very close physical proximity.

target_telephonic_remote.name: Telephonic / Remote Human
target_telephonic_remote.acoustic_signature: "Distance Compensation." Slightly louder than natural. Checking intonation (upward inflection) to verify connection. Clearer enunciation.

target_small_group.name: Small Group (Dinner Table)
target_small_group.acoustic_signature: Slight projection (2-3m radius). Phase shifts as speaker's head turns to address different people.

target_classroom_lecture.name: Lecture / Classroom
target_classroom_lecture.acoustic_signature: The "Teacher Voice." Projected from diaphragm. Pace deliberately slowed. Key terms heavily stressed.

target_drill_sergeant.name: Drill Sergeant (Platoon)
target_drill_sergeant.acoustic_signature: Maximum unamplified volume. Percussive staccato rhythm. Vowels shouted, consonants hard/spat.

target_street_orator.name: Soapbox / Street Orator
target_street_orator.acoustic_signature: Strained projection cutting through ambient noise. Repetitive looping cadences. Elevated pitch.

target_town_crier.name: Town Crier / Shouting Distance
target_town_crier.acoustic_signature: Vowels heavily elongated to carry over distance. Consonants dropped. Significant delay between phrases.

target_public_pa.name: Public Speaker (PA System)
target_public_pa.acoustic_signature: The "Politician." High energy but controlled volume. Large dynamic range. Dramatic pauses.

target_broadcaster.name: News Anchor / Broadcaster
target_broadcaster.acoustic_signature: The "News Prosody." Artificial, polished pitch contours. Non-regional accent. No waiting for response.

target_podcaster.name: Podcaster / Radio Host
target_podcaster.acoustic_signature: "False Intimacy." Close-mic technique (warm, dry, bass-heavy) but performative/projected energy.

target_stage_actor.name: Stage Actor (Theatrics)
target_stage_actor.acoustic_signature: The "Stage Whisper." A whisper loud enough for the back row. Over-articulation of final consonants.

target_infant.name: Infant-Directed (Parentese)
target_infant.acoustic_signature: High pitch baseline. Exaggerated swooping pitch contours. Simplified vocabulary. Slow, repetitive tempo.

target_animal.name: Animal-Directed (Pet Voice)
target_animal.acoustic_signature: Similar to parentese but includes clicks, kissy-noises, whistles, short command bursts. Tone swings between affection and command.

target_machine_voice.name: Voice Assistant (Siri/Alexa)
target_machine_voice.acoustic_signature: The "Robot Talk." Hyper-correct pronunciation. Unnatural pauses between words. Flat intonation. Emotion removed.

target_dictation.name: Dictation (Recording for Transcribing)
target_dictation.acoustic_signature: The "Typewriter" voice. Fast, steady, monotone. Punctuation spoken aloud. Zero emotional affect.

target_hard_of_hearing.name: To Deaf / Hard of Hearing
target_hard_of_hearing.acoustic_signature: The "Loud & Slow." Volume consistently high. Tempo dragged. Articulation exaggerated for lip-reading.

target_non_native.name: To Non-Native Speaker
target_non_native.acoustic_signature: The "Simplifier." Grammar stripped down. Words separated by distinct gaps. Volume unnecessarily loud.

target_interrupter.name: The Interrupter
target_interrupter.acoustic_signature: The "Cut-In." Higher pitch and faster tempo to steal the floor. Voice urgent, pushing against the other person's rhythm.

_meta.concept: The social game being played. Captures psychological intent, power dynamics, register, and emotional masking.
_meta.annotation_instruction: Based on prosodic and register cues. Listen for masking, status, and stakes.

social_boardroom_negotiation.name: Boardroom / Business Negotiation
social_boardroom_negotiation.acoustic_signature: The "Alpha Shield." Guarded, low-pitched, steady. Deliberate lack of emotional leakage. Competitive but polite turn-taking.

social_customer_service_mask.name: Customer Service (The Mask)
social_customer_service_mask.acoustic_signature: The "Smile-Voice." Pitch artificially raised. High uptalk usage. Articulation clear but emotion detached or plastic.

social_legal_bureaucratic.name: Legal / Bureaucratic
social_legal_bureaucratic.acoustic_signature: The "Fine Print." Rapid-fire monotone delivery. Emphasis on qualifying words. Zero melody; goal is accuracy.

social_medical_clinical.name: Medical / Clinical Assessment
social_medical_clinical.acoustic_signature: The "Detach." Gentle but investigative. Soft to soothe, clinically distant for authority. Falling intonation for questions.

social_job_interview.name: Job Interview (The Applicant)
social_job_interview.acoustic_signature: The "Anxious Professional." High energy masked by careful grammar. Agreement noises. Over-enunciation. Shallow breath from nerves.

social_argument_domestic.name: Domestic Argument (Cyclical)
social_argument_domestic.acoustic_signature: The "Nag/Whine." Overlapping speech. Nasal or high-pitched complaining. Cyclical repetition with increasing frustration.

social_interrogation_police.name: Interrogation / Police Interaction
social_interrogation_police.acoustic_signature: The "Power Imbalance." One voice stern using silence as weapon; other voice shaky with hedging language.

social_plea_desperate.name: Pleading / Begging
social_plea_desperate.acoustic_signature: The "Submission." High pitch, shaky breath, creaky onset. Speaker talks quickly before being cut off. Submissive tone.

social_emergency_panic.name: Emergency / Crisis (911)
social_emergency_panic.acoustic_signature: The "Suppression." Hyperventilating but forcing steady voice. Rapid rate, high pitch, staccato delivery.

social_bullying_intimidation.name: Bullying / Intimidation
social_bullying_intimidation.acoustic_signature: The "Growl." Pitch drops to bottom of range. Tempo slows to invade acoustic space. Lazy but threatening articulation.

social_passive_aggressive.name: Passive-Aggressive
social_passive_aggressive.acoustic_signature: The "Sugar-Coated Knife." Sweet polite tone but stress falls on wrong words. Frequent heavy sighing implying judgment.

social_pillow_talk.name: Pillow Talk / Post-Coital
social_pillow_talk.acoustic_signature: The "Melt." Extreme vocal fry. Very slow tempo. Minimal articulation. Long comfortable silences. Voice unprojected.

social_flirt_attraction.name: Flirting / Attraction
social_flirt_attraction.acoustic_signature: The "Play." Breathy voice. Frequent soft laughter. Men drop pitch; women raise pitch or use head voice. Teasing rhythm.

social_gossip_conspiracy.name: Gossip / Sharing Secrets
social_gossip_conspiracy.acoustic_signature: The "Huddle." Rapid-fire pacing, hushed volume, sudden pitch spikes. Intonation invites listener into exclusive circle.

social_comforting_soothe.name: Comforting / Consoling
social_comforting_soothe.acoustic_signature: The "Blanket." Steady, rhythmic, low-frequency hum. Downward inflections on every sentence. Speaker matches distressed person's breathing.

social_confession_guilt.name: Confession / Admitting Guilt
social_confession_guilt.acoustic_signature: The "Drop." Volume drops at moment of truth. Hesitation markers increase. Speaker avoids assertive downward intonation.

social_brotalk_locker.name: Bro-Talk / Locker Room
social_brotalk_locker.acoustic_signature: The "Posturing." Loud volume, heavy slang. Boisterous percussive laughter. Frequent friendly interruptions.

social_awkward_stranger.name: Awkwardness / Strangers
social_awkward_stranger.acoustic_signature: The "Gap." Frequent uncomfortable silences. Excessive filler laughs. Topics shift rapidly.

social_party_mingle.name: Party / Cocktail Hour
social_party_mingle.acoustic_signature: The "Lombard Shift." Projecting over background noise while trying to sound casual. Elevated pitch, short punchy sentences.

social_gaming_team.name: Online Gaming (Co-op)
social_gaming_team.acoustic_signature: The "Tactical." Mix of high-stress callouts and casual banter. Instant code-switching between focus mode and social mode.

social_storytelling_camp.name: Storytelling / Campfire
social_storytelling_camp.acoustic_signature: The "Theater." Wide dynamic range. Character voices. Hypnotic rhythm.

social_toast_speech.name: Wedding Toast / Eulogy
social_toast_speech.acoustic_signature: The "Nervous Formal." Poor projection with public speaking tremor mixed with sentimental language. Overly long pauses.

social_sermon_preach.name: Preaching / Religious Service
social_sermon_preach.acoustic_signature: The "Cadence." Musical rhythmic delivery. Huge dynamic swells. Call-and-response gaps.

social_military_command.name: Military / Drill Command
social_military_command.acoustic_signature: The "Bark." Zero emotion. Maximum volume. Words clipped short for distance carry without echoing.

social_deceptive_lying.name: Lying / Deception
social_deceptive_lying.acoustic_signature: The "Cognitive Load." Subtle pitch increase. Over-explanation. Inconsistency between word confidence and voice shakiness.

social_complaining_whine.name: Chronic Complaining
social_complaining_whine.acoustic_signature: The "Drone." Nasal resonance. Repetitive sing-song pitch contour. Elongated vowels to emphasize suffering.

social_drunk_intoxicated.name: Intoxicated / Drunk
social_drunk_intoxicated.acoustic_signature: The "Slur." Loss of tongue motor control. Volume control fails. Emotional volatility.

social_scolding_discipline.name: Scolding / Disciplining
social_scolding_discipline.acoustic_signature: The "Teacher Tone." Low pitch, slow tempo. Distinct word separation. Heavy final intonation drop.

social_mockery_sarcasm.name: Mockery / Sarcasm
social_mockery_sarcasm.acoustic_signature: The "Caricature." Nasal exaggerated tone mimicking someone. Extreme pitch contours.

social_grief_mourning.name: Grief / Active Mourning
social_grief_mourning.acoustic_signature: The "hollow." A voice emptied of its normal energy. Long, vacant pauses. The pitch is low and monotone, punctuated by sudden cracks into crying. Sentences start with intention but collapse midway. Swallowing is frequent and audible as the speaker fights the lump in the throat. A quality of disbelief — "this can't be real" — pervades the tone.

social_heartbreak.name: Heartbreak / Romantic Devastation
social_heartbreak.acoustic_signature: The "shatter." The voice wavers between numb flatness and sudden sobbing outbursts. Sentences are obsessively repetitive ("I can't believe...", "How could..."). The pitch is unstable — the speaker cannot find their normal register. Breath hitches (mini-sobs) interrupt even calm sentences. A raw, exposed vulnerability makes every word sound like it physically hurts.

social_ecstatic_joy.name: Ecstatic Joy / Overwhelming Happiness
social_ecstatic_joy.acoustic_signature: The "burst." Volume spikes uncontrollably. Pitch jumps to the top of the speaker's range. Speech rate accelerates until words tumble over each other. Laughter and crying become indistinguishable (tears of joy). The speaker may scream, jump, or hyperventilate. Sentences are fragmentary — the emotion overflows faster than language can contain it.

social_jealousy_envy.name: Jealousy / Corrosive Envy
social_jealousy_envy.acoustic_signature: The "acid." A controlled but bitter tone. The voice is tight, clipped, and slightly higher than baseline from tension. Fake congratulations sound hollow — the smile doesn't reach the voice. Sarcastic undertones bleed through despite effort. The speaker often falls silent when the object of envy is discussed, then re-enters with forced casualness.

social_panic_attack.name: Panic Attack / Anxiety Spiral
social_panic_attack.acoustic_signature: The "spiral." Hyperventilation dominates — rapid, shallow, audible gasping that the speaker cannot control. Speech is fragmented, repetitive, and catastrophic ("I'm dying," "I can't breathe"). The voice is high-pitched and quavering. Physical symptoms (tingling, chest pain) make the speaker sound genuinely medically distressed. Attempts to speak trigger more hyperventilation.

social_shame_humiliation.name: Public Humiliation / Crushing Shame
social_shame_humiliation.acoustic_signature: The "shrink." The voice physically retracts — volume drops to near-inaudible. The speaker wishes to disappear. Sentences trail off into nothing. The pitch is flat and defeated. If forced to speak, the voice cracks. Swallowing and throat-clearing increase as the body physically tightens. The speaker avoids eye contact, and the voice follows — directed at the floor.

social_nostalgia_longing.name: Nostalgia / Deep Longing / Homesickness
social_nostalgia_longing.acoustic_signature: The "ache." A warm but sorrowful tone. The voice softens and slows as the speaker enters the memory. Pitch descends gently. Sentences lengthen and become poetic or descriptive. Sighing is frequent. A bittersweet smile is audible — the voice is simultaneously fond and pained. Long pauses as the speaker lingers in the feeling.

social_religious_ecstasy.name: Religious Ecstasy / Spiritual Rapture
social_religious_ecstasy.acoustic_signature: The "transcendence." The voice breaks free of normal conversational patterns into something chant-like, glossolalic, or sing-song. Pitch soars. The tempo becomes rhythmic and almost musical. The speaker may cry, laugh, or fall into ecstatic repetition. Rationality and self-monitoring are abandoned — the voice sounds possessed or channeling.

social_dissociation.name: Dissociation / Emotional Numbness / Derealization
social_dissociation.acoustic_signature: The "glass wall." Flat, robotic affect. The speaker sounds like they are narrating someone else's life. Zero pitch variation. Responses are delayed as if traveling through fog. The voice has an eerie calm that is more disturbing than screaming. Words are technically coherent but emotionally vacant. No filler words — just empty, precise statements.

social_manic_episode.name: Manic Episode / Hypomania
social_manic_episode.acoustic_signature: The "rocket." Extremely fast, pressured speech — the speaker cannot stop talking. Ideas cascade and jump tangentially (flight of ideas). Volume is too loud. Grandiosity inflates the tone — everything sounds like a TED talk. Laughter is frequent and unearned. The speaker interrupts themselves before finishing sentences to start new ones. Energy feels limitless but brittle.

social_fury_rage.name: Blind Fury / Uncontrolled Rage
social_fury_rage.acoustic_signature: The "eruption." Maximum volume delivered from the gut. Vocal cords are slammed together — the voice is rough, distorted, and may crack from sheer force. Sentences become short, percussive attacks. Profanity increases. Pitch drops to the basement or jumps to screaming. Breathing is heavy and snorting. Objects may be thrown or struck — crashes and impacts in background.

social_relief_catharsis.name: Profound Relief / Cathartic Release
social_relief_catharsis.acoustic_signature: The "exhale." A long, shuddering outbreath that carries the weight of sustained tension. The voice trembles but is rising — pitch lifts with hope. Laughter and tears mix freely. The speaker may collapse physically (audible body drop or slump). Sentences often begin with "Oh my God" or "Thank God." The tone transitions from shaky to warm over seconds.

social_phone_sex.name: Phone Sex / Audio Erotica
social_phone_sex.acoustic_signature: The "performance." Breathy, low-pitched, deliberately seductive vocal quality. The speaker narrates actions and sensations in real-time — slow, descriptive, and hypnotic. Moans and sighs are semi-performative (louder and more shaped than genuine arousal). Close-mic proximity effect makes the voice warm and bass-heavy. Pauses are filled with audible breathing.

social_dirty_talk.name: Dirty Talk / Verbal Domination
social_dirty_talk.acoustic_signature: The "command." Low pitch, authoritative delivery. Words are chosen for shock value and spoken with deliberate, hard articulation. The tone oscillates between growling dominance and breathy seduction. Profanity is weaponized — delivered with relish. Volume modulates between whispered threats in the ear and firm, projected commands.

social_dom_sub_dynamic.name: Dom/Sub Power Exchange
social_dom_sub_dynamic.acoustic_signature: The "polarity." Two distinct vocal registers in one interaction: the Dominant voice is steady, low, slow, and uses clipped commands with falling intonation ("Kneel." "Look at me."). The Submissive voice is high, breathy, compliant, and uses rising intonation seeking approval ("Yes, Sir?" "Like this?"). The power asymmetry is entirely audible.

social_seduction_calculated.name: Calculated Seduction / The Approach
social_seduction_calculated.acoustic_signature: The "velvet." Every vocal parameter is consciously optimized. Pitch is lowered. Tempo is slowed. Pauses are loaded with intention. The speaker mirrors the target's speech patterns (rapport building). Compliments are delivered with a slight breathiness. Laughter is strategically placed. The voice sounds effortlessly charming — which requires enormous effort.

social_sexual_rejection.name: Sexual Rejection / Turning Someone Down
social_sexual_rejection.acoustic_signature: The "wall." Abrupt shift from warm to firm. The pitch flattens. Volume drops but clarity increases — every word is deliberate to leave no ambiguity. "No" is said with a downward inflection and a period, not a question mark. Awkwardness creates audible discomfort: throat clearing, shifted posture, and a desire to exit the conversation quickly.

social_hookup_casual.name: Casual Hookup / One-Night Stand Negotiation
social_hookup_casual.acoustic_signature: The "shortcut." Fast-forwarded intimacy — the voice is warmer and more familiar than the actual relationship warrants. Both speakers use a lot of nervous laughter to mask vulnerability. Volume is conspiratorially low (don't want friends/roommates to hear). Sentences are short and logistical ("Your place or mine?") masked in casual affect.

social_bdsm_aftercare.name: BDSM Aftercare / Post-Scene Recovery
social_bdsm_aftercare.acoustic_signature: The "landing." The Dominant voice shifts from commanding to extremely tender — soft, low, reassuring. The Submissive voice is small, shaky, and child-like (subdrop). Both voices are exhausted and intimate. Blanket rustling, water sipping, and soft physical contact sounds. The rhythm is slow and repetitive — "You did so well," "I've got you" — like soothing an infant.

social_consent_negotiation.name: Sexual Consent Negotiation / Boundary Setting
social_consent_negotiation.acoustic_signature: The "checkpoint." A deliberate shift from aroused/playful to serious/clear. The voice becomes notably more sober, slower, and articulate. Rising intonation for genuine questions ("Is this okay?"). The listener's response is carefully attended to — silence triggers a full stop. If boundaries are stated, the voice is firm but not hostile. An audible gear-shift back to arousal follows a clear "yes."

social_apology_sincere.name: Sincere Apology / Making Amends
social_apology_sincere.acoustic_signature: The "kneel." The voice drops in volume and pitch — the speaker makes themselves acoustically smaller. Sentences are carefully constructed, then often restarted ("What I mean is..."). The tone is heavy with genuine remorse. Pauses are frequent as the speaker monitors the listener's reaction. The voice may crack if the apology touches deep guilt.

social_goodbye_permanent.name: Permanent Goodbye / Final Farewell
social_goodbye_permanent.acoustic_signature: The "last page." Every word is weighed because there won't be more. The voice is thick with suppressed emotion — trembling but controlled. Speaking rate slows to an almost ceremonial pace. The speaker memorizes the moment — sensory descriptions increase. Silences are full, not empty. The voice may break on the very last word.

social_reunion_surprise.name: Surprise Reunion / Seeing a Loved One
social_reunion_surprise.acoustic_signature: The "shockwave." An involuntary gasp or scream at recognition. The voice immediately jumps to maximum pitch and volume — then collapses into sobbing or laughter. Speech is incoherent fragments ("Oh my God! You're—how—I can't—"). The speaker physically moves toward the person, creating Doppler shifts and rustling. Pure, unfiltered emotion.

social_therapy_session.name: Therapy Session / Emotional Unpacking
social_therapy_session.acoustic_signature: The "excavation." Starts with guarded, careful speech (intellectualizing). Gradually, the voice softens and cracks as defenses lower. Long pauses where the speaker stares into the middle distance. The therapist's prompts are gentle with upward inflection. Breakthrough moments sound like the voice "giving way" — a sudden shift from controlled to raw, followed by tears or silence.

social_vulnerable_admission.name: Admitting Vulnerability / "I'm Not Okay"
social_vulnerable_admission.acoustic_signature: The "crack." The speaker has been performing strength, and the mask slips. The transition is audible — the voice abruptly drops from confident to small. Breath becomes shaky. The speaker often laughs nervously immediately after the admission to re-armor. Pitch wavers. Volume falls to barely audible. The hardest sentences in the human repertoire.

social_revenge_cold.name: Cold Revenge / Calculated Payback
social_revenge_cold.acoustic_signature: The "ice." The voice is eerily calm and measured — the opposite of hot anger. Pitch is low, tempo is slow, and every word lands with deliberate weight. There is a satisfaction audible in the control — the speaker has rehearsed this. Smiling while threatening. The lack of emotional leakage is itself terrifying. "I've been waiting to tell you this."

social_betrayal_discovery.name: Discovering Betrayal / Trust Shattered
social_betrayal_discovery.acoustic_signature: The "break." A stunned, breathless quality. The speaker repeats what they've learned in disbelief ("You... you did what?"). The voice is quiet — shock suppresses volume. Then comes the wave: pitch rises, volume explodes, and the voice cracks. The transition from numb to volcanic happens in seconds. Accusations become fragmented, circling back to the central wound.

_meta.concept: The physical space surrounding the speaker. Determines reverb characteristics, ambient noise floor, and acoustic reflections that color the voice.
_meta.annotation_instruction: Listen for reverb tail length, early reflections, ambient noise type, and proximity effects caused by the environment.

env_bathroom_tiled.name: Tiled Bathroom / Shower
env_bathroom_tiled.acoustic_signature: Bright, harsh reverb with strong early reflections off hard parallel surfaces. Flutter echo on sharp consonants. The "singing in the shower" resonance amplifies the voice, making it sound larger than it is.

env_closet_padded.name: Walk-in Closet / Padded Room
env_closet_padded.acoustic_signature: Acoustically "dead." Fabric absorbs all reflections. The voice sounds dry, flat, and unusually close. No sense of space. Often used as improvised vocal booths.

env_bedroom_carpeted.name: Carpeted Bedroom
env_bedroom_carpeted.acoustic_signature: Warm, moderate absorption. Soft surfaces dampen high frequencies. The voice sounds intimate and natural. Slight low-frequency reinforcement from bed/furniture.

env_elevator_metal.name: Elevator / Metal Box
env_elevator_metal.acoustic_signature: Metallic flutter echo in a tiny space. The voice bounces between parallel steel walls creating a harsh, ringing quality. Mechanical hum and cable noise in background.

env_stairwell_concrete.name: Concrete Stairwell
env_stairwell_concrete.acoustic_signature: Long, bright reverb spiraling upward. Hard surfaces create strong reflections. Footstep echoes compete with speech. Voice sounds grandiose but harsh.

env_corridor_hallway.name: Long Hallway / Corridor
env_corridor_hallway.acoustic_signature: Distinctive "tunnel" reverb. Sound travels linearly with long decay. Footsteps echo rhythmically. Voice gains an eerie, elongated quality.

env_cathedral_stone.name: Cathedral / Stone Church
env_cathedral_stone.acoustic_signature: Massive reverb tail (3-6 seconds). Stone walls create warm, enveloping reflections. Speech intelligibility drops; only slow, deliberate speech cuts through. Organ-like low-frequency resonance.

env_gymnasium_empty.name: Empty Gymnasium / Sports Hall
env_gymnasium_empty.acoustic_signature: Harsh, metallic flutter echo off polished floors and high ceilings. The voice sounds thin and echoey. Sneaker squeaks and ball bounces in the background.

env_auditorium_stage.name: Theater / Auditorium Stage
env_auditorium_stage.acoustic_signature: Designed acoustics with controlled reverb. The voice projects clearly into the space. Stage monitors may create slight delay. The speaker hears their own voice returning from the back wall.

env_warehouse_industrial.name: Warehouse / Factory Floor
env_warehouse_industrial.acoustic_signature: Industrial echo with machinery hum. High ceilings create long reverb but hard surfaces make it harsh. Safety alarms, forklifts, and ventilation compete with speech.

env_office_open.name: Open Plan Office
env_office_open.acoustic_signature: Moderate reverb dampened by cubicle partitions. HVAC white noise floor. Background murmur of other conversations. The speaker unconsciously lowers volume for privacy.

env_open_field.name: Open Field / Plain
env_open_field.acoustic_signature: Zero reflections. The voice sounds small and unsupported, quickly absorbed by open air. Wind is the primary interference. No bass reinforcement.

env_forest_dense.name: Dense Forest / Jungle
env_forest_dense.acoustic_signature: Scattered absorption from trees and foliage. The voice sounds dampened and "swallowed" by the environment. Bird calls, insects, and rustling leaves in background.

env_urban_street.name: City Street
env_urban_street.acoustic_signature: Complex reflection pattern off buildings. Traffic noise (60-80dB) triggers strong Lombard effect. Emergency sirens, construction, and crowd noise compete for attention.

env_mountain_peak.name: Mountain Summit / Cliff Edge
env_mountain_peak.acoustic_signature: Thin air reduces projection power. Wind is fierce and constant. Dramatic echoes off cliff faces with long delay. The speaker must shout but has less breath to do it.

env_beach_shore.name: Beach / Shoreline
env_beach_shore.acoustic_signature: Rhythmic wave crash provides constant low-frequency background. Open space with sand absorption. Wind exposure. Voice sounds clear but unanchored.

env_rain_heavy.name: In Heavy Rain / Thunderstorm
env_rain_heavy.acoustic_signature: Continuous broadband noise from rain hitting surfaces. Thunder interrupts. The speaker raises volume significantly. Water on face may affect articulation.

env_underwater_partial.name: Partially Submerged / Water Surface
env_underwater_partial.acoustic_signature: Gurgling, splashing interference. Voice alternates between clear (above water) and completely muffled (submerged). Gasping for air between phrases.

env_sealed_helmet.name: Inside Sealed Helmet / Space Suit
env_sealed_helmet.acoustic_signature: Voice reverberates inside the helmet cavity. Breathing is amplified and claustrophobic. Radio crackle on transmission. The voice sounds tinny and confined.

env_cave_underground.name: Cave / Underground Tunnel
env_cave_underground.acoustic_signature: Deep, booming reverb with irregular reflections. Dripping water provides rhythmic background. The voice has a primordial, resonant quality. Low frequencies amplified.

env_moving_vehicle_interior.name: Inside Moving Vehicle (Car/Bus)
env_moving_vehicle_interior.acoustic_signature: Engine drone provides constant low-frequency bed. Road noise (tire hiss) adds white noise. Vibration affects voice stability. Lombard effect engaged.

env_aircraft_cabin.name: Aircraft Cabin (Pressurized)
env_aircraft_cabin.acoustic_signature: Intense broadband engine noise (75-85dB). Pressurized air dries the throat. The speaker must lean close and project. Ear pressure affects self-monitoring of volume.

_meta.concept: Medical, biological, or physiological conditions of the speaker that alter voice production at the source. These are states of the body itself, not external forces.
_meta.annotation_instruction: Listen for pathological voice qualities - hoarseness, breathiness, nasality, reduced range, tremor, or unusual effort in phonation.

hlth_common_cold.name: Head Cold / Nasal Congestion
hlth_common_cold.acoustic_signature: The "stuffed" voice. Nasal consonants (M, N, NG) become oral (M->B, N->D). Resonance shifts away from nasal cavity. Frequent sniffling, throat clearing, and nose blowing interrupt speech.

hlth_sore_throat.name: Sore Throat / Laryngitis
hlth_sore_throat.acoustic_signature: The "sandpaper" voice. Hoarse, raspy phonation with reduced pitch range. The speaker winces audibly on swallowing. Volume is limited because pushing air past inflamed folds is painful.

hlth_asthma_attack.name: Asthma / Restricted Airway
hlth_asthma_attack.acoustic_signature: Audible wheeze on both inhalation and exhalation. Sentences are extremely short (3-5 words max). The voice sounds "squeezed" through a narrowed passage. Inhaler clicks may be present.

hlth_allergies_seasonal.name: Seasonal Allergies
hlth_allergies_seasonal.acoustic_signature: Watery, itchy quality. Frequent sneezing fits. Eyes watering affects facial tension. Nasal drip creates a perpetual "post-nasal" thickness. Antihistamine dryness may also be present.

hlth_fever_high.name: High Fever / Delirium
hlth_fever_high.acoustic_signature: The "wavering" voice. Temperature dysregulation causes shivering and sweating. Speech may become confused or hallucinatory. Pitch is unstable. Dry, cracked lips affect bilabials.

hlth_dehydration_severe.name: Severe Dehydration
hlth_dehydration_severe.acoustic_signature: The "cracked" voice. Mouth is parched--audible sticky lip sounds and tongue clicks. Saliva is insufficient, causing harsh frictional noise on sibilants. Voice fatigues rapidly.

hlth_low_blood_sugar.name: Low Blood Sugar / Hypoglycemia
hlth_low_blood_sugar.acoustic_signature: The "fading" voice. Hands trembling affects jaw stability. Speech becomes slurred and confused, similar to intoxication. Volume drops. Concentration breaks mid-sentence.

hlth_pregnancy_late.name: Late Pregnancy (Third Trimester)
hlth_pregnancy_late.acoustic_signature: Compressed diaphragm from enlarged uterus. Breathlessness even at rest. Voice sounds effortful. Frequent sighing. Posture-related discomfort audible in shifting and adjusting.

hlth_altitude_sickness.name: Altitude Sickness
hlth_altitude_sickness.acoustic_signature: Gasping for adequate oxygen. Speech is slow with frequent deep breaths. Headache pain audible as wincing. Confusion may cause word-finding difficulty.

hlth_dental_numbed.name: Post-Dental Work (Numbed)
hlth_dental_numbed.acoustic_signature: The "novocaine" voice. Half the face is paralyzed. Bilabials (B, P, M) are sloppy. Drooling may occur. The speaker compensates by over-articulating the working side.

hlth_jaw_wired.name: Jaw Injury / Wired Shut
hlth_jaw_wired.acoustic_signature: Severe articulation restriction. All speech passes through clenched teeth. Consonants requiring jaw movement (wide vowels, bilabials) are almost impossible. Voice sounds muffled and strained.

hlth_concussion.name: Concussion / Head Injury
hlth_concussion.acoustic_signature: The "fog" voice. Slow processing speed. Long pauses searching for words. Monotone delivery. Volume may be inappropriately loud (difficulty self-monitoring).

hlth_vocal_nodules.name: Vocal Nodules / Cord Damage
hlth_vocal_nodules.acoustic_signature: Chronic hoarseness. The voice "breaks" unpredictably between registers. Breathy quality with air escaping through incomplete cord closure. Limited pitch range.

hlth_hearing_loss_speaker.name: Speaker Has Hearing Loss
hlth_hearing_loss_speaker.acoustic_signature: The "uncalibrated" voice. Volume is inappropriately loud (cannot self-monitor). Pitch may drift. Articulation is either overly precise (trained) or degraded (untrained). Sibilants are poorly controlled.

hlth_parkinsons_tremor.name: Parkinson's / Neurological Tremor
hlth_parkinsons_tremor.acoustic_signature: The "diminishing" voice. Progressive reduction in volume (hypophonia). Monotone pitch. Tremor creates a rhythmic wobble. Articulation becomes increasingly mumbled.

hlth_stroke_aphasia.name: Post-Stroke / Aphasia
hlth_stroke_aphasia.acoustic_signature: The "searching" voice. Long, frustrated pauses. Words come out wrong or garbled. The speaker knows what they want to say but the motor pathway is disrupted. Often accompanied by emotional frustration.

hlth_stuttering_chronic.name: Chronic Stutter / Disfluency
hlth_stuttering_chronic.acoustic_signature: Repetitions, prolongations, and blocks. Silent blocks where the speaker is physically unable to initiate phonation. Tension visible in pitch spikes at moment of release. Secondary behaviors (eye blinks, head nods) may be audible.

hlth_tourettes_vocal.name: Vocal Tics / Tourette's
hlth_tourettes_vocal.acoustic_signature: Involuntary vocal intrusions: sudden shouts, words, or sounds that interrupt the flow of normal speech. The speaker often continues immediately after the tic as if nothing happened.

_meta.concept: Physical barriers, coverings, or equipment on or near the speaker's face and head that mechanically filter, muffle, or distort the voice before it reaches the listener.
_meta.annotation_instruction: Listen for high-frequency damping, resonant cavity effects, breathing restriction, and mechanical noise from the equipment itself.

gear_surgical_mask.name: Surgical / Cloth Face Mask
gear_surgical_mask.acoustic_signature: High frequencies above 4kHz are attenuated by 3-12dB. Sibilants (S, SH, F) become muddy. Plosives (P, T, K) lose their burst. The speaker unconsciously raises volume 2-3dB to compensate. Breath sounds are amplified inside the mask.

gear_respirator_n95.name: N95 / Industrial Respirator
gear_respirator_n95.acoustic_signature: Heavy filtering effect. The voice sounds "behind a wall." Breathing is audibly restricted with a distinct valve-click on exhalation. Speech effort increases dramatically. Very poor intelligibility for quiet speakers.

gear_gas_mask_full.name: Full Gas Mask / CBRN
gear_gas_mask_full.acoustic_signature: The "Darth Vader" effect. Voice passes through a chemical filter, creating extreme muffling. Breathing sounds mechanical and menacing. The internal cavity creates a resonant, hollow quality. Communication requires near-shouting.

gear_oxygen_mask.name: Oxygen Mask / CPAP
gear_oxygen_mask.acoustic_signature: Plastic cup over nose and mouth dampens mid-frequencies. Constant hissing of oxygen flow. The voice sounds distant and "in a fishbowl." Speaker must project forcefully.

gear_motorcycle_helmet.name: Full-Face Motorcycle Helmet
gear_motorcycle_helmet.acoustic_signature: Voice reverberates inside the padded cavity. Visor creates a narrow acoustic aperture. Wind noise at speed makes speech nearly impossible. At rest, the voice sounds boomy and enclosed.

gear_space_helmet.name: Space Helmet / Sealed Visor
gear_space_helmet.acoustic_signature: Similar to gas mask but with added radio transmission artifacts--compression, limited bandwidth, static. Breathing is the dominant sound inside the helmet. The voice sounds tinny and robotic.

gear_medieval_helm.name: Medieval Helm / Full Visor
gear_medieval_helm.acoustic_signature: Metal resonance cavity. The voice rings metallically. The narrow eye slit acts as the only acoustic opening, creating a directional, muffled output. Clanking of the visor punctuates speech.

gear_hardhat_visor.name: Construction Hard Hat with Visor
gear_hardhat_visor.acoustic_signature: Minimal voice distortion but hard plastic reflects sound downward. Construction site noise in background. Speaker shouts. The hat rim creates a slight "cupping" of the voice.

gear_scarf_wrapped.name: Scarf / Balaclava Over Face
gear_scarf_wrapped.acoustic_signature: Fabric dampens all frequencies proportionally. Breath becomes warm and humid against the face, creating moist mouth sounds. The voice sounds muffled but retains more clarity than hard masks.

gear_hand_over_mouth.name: Hand Covering Mouth
gear_hand_over_mouth.acoustic_signature: Immediate, dramatic muffling. The hand acts as a low-pass filter. Often associated with shock or trying to stay quiet. Consonants that require lip visibility (labials) are severely impacted.

gear_pillow_face.name: Face Buried in Pillow / Cushion
gear_pillow_face.acoustic_signature: Extreme muffling--the voice is almost entirely absorbed. Only the loudest, lowest frequencies escape. Used when crying, screaming into a pillow, or lying face-down in bed.

gear_veil_niqab.name: Fabric Veil / Niqab
gear_veil_niqab.acoustic_signature: Subtle high-frequency damping. Less severe than a surgical mask because the fabric hangs loosely. The voice retains most characteristics but sounds slightly "filtered" to the listener.

gear_radio_ptt.name: Push-to-Talk Radio / Walkie-Talkie
gear_radio_ptt.acoustic_signature: Narrow bandwidth (300-3400Hz) eliminates bass warmth and treble air. Compression squashes dynamics. The "kkhht" of the PTT button bookends every transmission. "Over" protocol structures turn-taking.

gear_megaphone_bullhorn.name: Megaphone / Bullhorn
gear_megaphone_bullhorn.acoustic_signature: Extreme compression and distortion. The voice is clipped, harsh, and unnaturally loud. Feedback squeals punctuate pauses. All subtlety and nuance is destroyed in favor of raw volume.

_meta.concept: Weather, temperature, and atmospheric conditions that the speaker is physically enduring. These affect muscle tension, breathing patterns, and airway moisture.
_meta.annotation_instruction: Listen for involuntary muscle tension (shivering, panting), changes in breath moisture, and environmental noise signatures.

clmt_freezing_bitter.name: Bitter Cold / Sub-Zero
clmt_freezing_bitter.acoustic_signature: The "lockjaw." Facial muscles are numb and rigid. Jaw barely opens. Vowels are centralized ("uh" quality) because the tongue is sluggish. Visible breath vapor may cause slight acoustic distortion close to the mouth.

clmt_extreme_heat.name: Extreme Heat / Heatstroke
clmt_extreme_heat.acoustic_signature: The "wilted" voice. Dehydration dries the vocal folds. Panting replaces normal breathing. Speech is lethargic, slow, and broken by heavy exhalations. Sweat drips may be audible.

clmt_humid_tropical.name: Humid Tropical / Sauna
clmt_humid_tropical.acoustic_signature: Airway is saturated with moisture. The voice sounds "wet" and heavy. Breathing is deep but unsatisfying. Sweat and moisture create "slippery" mouth sounds.

clmt_strong_wind.name: Strong Wind / Gale
clmt_strong_wind.acoustic_signature: Wind buffets the microphone and face. The speaker turns away from the wind to breathe, creating directional shifts. Volume is raised to compete. Words are "torn away" before they reach the listener.

clmt_blizzard_whiteout.name: Blizzard / Snow Storm
clmt_blizzard_whiteout.acoustic_signature: Combines freezing cold (lockjaw) with wind noise and disorientation. The speaker shouts into the void. Snow dampens reflections, making the voice sound swallowed by the environment.

clmt_sandstorm_dust.name: Sandstorm / Dust Storm
clmt_sandstorm_dust.acoustic_signature: Speaker breathes through fabric or hand to filter particles. Coughing interrupts. The voice sounds muffled and desperate. Grit in the teeth affects sibilants.

clmt_high_altitude_thin.name: High Altitude / Thin Air
clmt_high_altitude_thin.acoustic_signature: Reduced oxygen makes every sentence an effort. Deep gasping breaths between short phrases. The voice lacks its usual power and projection. Light-headedness may cause slurring.

clmt_smoke_filled_room.name: Smoke-Filled Room / Fire
clmt_smoke_filled_room.acoustic_signature: The "char." Irritated airways cause raspy, coughing speech. Eyes watering and burning affects facial tension. Urgency in voice as survival instinct kicks in. Carbon monoxide may cause confusion.

clmt_underwater_rain.name: Torrential Rain (Exposed)
clmt_underwater_rain.acoustic_signature: Water streaming down the face enters the mouth. The speaker sputters. Voice competes with the roar of heavy rainfall. Sentences are shouted in gaps between thunder.

clmt_fog_dense.name: Dense Fog / Mist
clmt_fog_dense.acoustic_signature: Psychologically oppressive silence. Sound travels strangely--absorbed in some directions, amplified in others. The speaker often speaks louder than necessary, uncertain if they are being heard.

_meta.concept: Ingested, inhaled, or injected substances that alter neuromuscular control, cognitive function, or arousal state, thereby changing voice production.
_meta.annotation_instruction: Listen for motor control degradation, tempo changes, volume dysregulation, and emotional volatility not explained by context.

subst_caffeine_high.name: High Caffeine Intake
subst_caffeine_high.acoustic_signature: The "wired" voice. Speech rate increases 15-25%. Pitch baseline rises slightly. Articulation is sharp but jittery. The speaker may talk over others or fail to pause. Restless energy audible in rapid breathing.

subst_amphetamine_stimulant.name: Stimulant (Amphetamine/MDMA)
subst_amphetamine_stimulant.acoustic_signature: The "machine gun." Extremely rapid, pressured speech. Jaw clenching (bruxism) distorts consonants. Dry mouth creates sticky articulation sounds. Emotional intensity is disproportionate to content.

subst_cocaine_rush.name: Cocaine / Strong Stimulant Rush
subst_cocaine_rush.acoustic_signature: Nasal damage creates audible sniffing and congestion. Speech is grandiose, confident, and fast. Volume is too loud. The speaker interrupts constantly. Numbed throat affects swallowing.

subst_adrenaline_natural.name: Natural Adrenaline Surge
subst_adrenaline_natural.acoustic_signature: The "survival" voice. Pitch jumps. Time perception warps--speech is fast but feels slow to the speaker. Tunnel-vision focus makes speech extremely direct and stripped of social niceties.

subst_alcohol_tipsy.name: Mildly Intoxicated (1-3 drinks)
subst_alcohol_tipsy.acoustic_signature: The "loosened" voice. Social inhibitions drop. Laughter comes easier. Slight volume increase. Very subtle slurring on complex consonant clusters. Emotional range widens.

subst_alcohol_heavily_drunk.name: Heavily Intoxicated
subst_alcohol_heavily_drunk.acoustic_signature: The "wreck." Severe slurring--sibilants smear, plosives lose their stop. Volume swings wildly. Emotional volatility (crying to laughing). Balance issues cause the voice to sway with the body.

subst_opioid_sedated.name: Opioid / Heavy Sedation
subst_opioid_sedated.acoustic_signature: The "nod." Extremely slow speech with long pauses. Volume drops to near-whisper. The speaker trails off mid-sentence as consciousness fades. Voice is breathy and lacks any tension or attack.

subst_benzodiazepine_calm.name: Benzodiazepine / Tranquilizer
subst_benzodiazepine_calm.acoustic_signature: The "flatline." Emotional affect is completely blunted. Speech is coherent but robotically calm. No excitement, no fear, no urgency. Muscles are relaxed, creating slightly mushy articulation.

subst_marijuana_high.name: Cannabis / THC
subst_marijuana_high.acoustic_signature: The "drift." Slower speech rate with frequent "spacing out" pauses. Dry mouth (cottonmouth) creates sticky lip sounds. Giggly. Thought patterns meander. Volume is usually lower than baseline.

subst_psychedelic_trip.name: Psychedelic (LSD/Psilocybin)
subst_psychedelic_trip.acoustic_signature: The "wonder." Speech becomes philosophical and tangential. Long pauses for overwhelming sensory experiences. Pitch range expands dramatically. The speaker may laugh, cry, or fall silent in rapid succession.

subst_anesthesia_waking.name: Post-Anesthesia / Waking From Sedation
subst_anesthesia_waking.acoustic_signature: The "emergence." Confused, slurred, childlike speech. Volume and pitch are uncontrolled. The speaker may say things they would normally filter. Motor control returns gradually--early speech is nearly unintelligible.

subst_nicotine_chronic.name: Chronic Heavy Smoking
subst_nicotine_chronic.acoustic_signature: The "gravel." Permanent vocal fold thickening from years of irritation. Lowered pitch baseline. Raspy, rough quality. Frequent throat clearing. Reduced pitch range. Morning voice is especially damaged.

_meta.concept: The speaker's current energy level, sleep status, and recovery state. These determine the baseline "fuel" available for voice production.
_meta.annotation_instruction: Listen for reduced volume, slower tempo, pitch dropping, vocal fry increase, trailing sentences, and overall "dimming" of the voice.

fatg_just_woken.name: Just Woken Up (Morning Voice)
fatg_just_woken.acoustic_signature: The "gravel bed." Vocal folds are swollen from overnight fluid redistribution. Pitch is at its lowest point of the day. Extreme vocal fry. Articulation is sluggish. The voice "warms up" over 15-30 minutes.

fatg_sleep_deprived_24h.name: 24+ Hours Without Sleep
fatg_sleep_deprived_24h.acoustic_signature: The "zombie." Microsleep pauses where the speaker blanks out mid-word. Slurred articulation resembling mild intoxication. Flat affect. The voice sounds hollow and lifeless. Yawning interrupts frequently.

fatg_falling_asleep.name: Drifting Off / Nodding Off
fatg_falling_asleep.acoustic_signature: The "descent." Sentences start at normal pace but slow dramatically, trailing into mumbles. Volume decreases progressively. Words merge together. The speaker may jerk awake and restart mid-thought.

fatg_post_nap_groggy.name: Post-Nap Grogginess (Sleep Inertia)
fatg_post_nap_groggy.acoustic_signature: The "fog." Confused, disoriented quality. The speaker doesn't know what time it is. Voice is thick and heavy. Responses are delayed. Cognitive function is worse than pre-nap for 10-20 minutes.

fatg_insomnia_chronic.name: Chronic Insomnia / Long-Term Sleep Debt
fatg_insomnia_chronic.acoustic_signature: The "hollow." Perpetual low energy. No vocal "peaks"--the dynamic range is compressed. The voice has an anxious, tense quality underlying the exhaustion. Dark circles audible in the tone.

fatg_post_exercise_high.name: Post-Exercise Endorphin High
fatg_post_exercise_high.acoustic_signature: The "glow." Voice is energized, open, and clear. Breathing is still elevated but controlled. Confidence and positivity leak into tone. Articulation is crisp.

fatg_complete_exhaustion.name: Complete Physical Exhaustion
fatg_complete_exhaustion.acoustic_signature: The "empty tank." Cannot project. Every word costs effort. Long recovery breaths between phrases. The voice sounds like it is being squeezed from a nearly empty tube.

fatg_second_wind.name: Second Wind (Late Night Energy)
fatg_second_wind.acoustic_signature: The "manic." An artificial, slightly delirious energy spike. Speech becomes fast and giggly. The voice has a "punchy" quality that feels unsustainable. Laughter comes too easily.

fatg_deep_meditation.name: Deep Meditation / Trance
fatg_deep_meditation.acoustic_signature: The "center." Extremely slow, deliberate speech. Perfect breath control. Voice is soft but clear. Zero tension in the throat. Each word feels intentionally placed.

fatg_post_massage_relaxed.name: Deep Relaxation (Post-Massage/Bath)
fatg_post_massage_relaxed.acoustic_signature: The "melt." Languid, unhurried speech. Muscles are so relaxed that articulation is loose. The voice sounds warm and satisfied. No urgency whatsoever.

fatg_jet_lagged.name: Jet Lag / Circadian Disruption
fatg_jet_lagged.acoustic_signature: The "disconnect." The voice is at odds with the environment--exhausted at noon, wired at midnight. Cognitive fog causes word-finding difficulty. Yawning at inappropriate times.

fatg_caffeine_crash.name: Caffeine / Sugar Crash
fatg_caffeine_crash.acoustic_signature: The "wall." Abrupt energy drop after stimulant wears off. Speech slows noticeably. Irritability enters the tone. The speaker sounds deflated and resentful.

fatg_hitting_wall.name: Hitting the Wall (Endurance Collapse)
fatg_hitting_wall.acoustic_signature: The "bonk." A sudden, cliff-edge energy drop during sustained exertion (marathon mile 20, hour 3 of a hike). The voice was functional moments ago and now sounds hollow, slurred, and confused — resembling hypoglycemia. Speech becomes monosyllabic. The speaker may become emotionally volatile (crying for no reason). Breathing is inefficient and labored.

fatg_oxygen_debt.name: Post-Sprint Oxygen Debt
fatg_oxygen_debt.acoustic_signature: The "payback." Immediately after max-effort exertion. Breathing is violent, gasping, and completely involuntary — it hijacks the vocal system. The speaker bends over (compressed chest), hands on knees. Speech is impossible for 30-60 seconds. First words come out as breathy, shaky whispers between heaving breaths. Nausea may be audible (gagging, spitting).

fatg_heat_exhaustion.name: Heat Exhaustion / Overheating
fatg_heat_exhaustion.acoustic_signature: The "wilt." Dehydration dries the vocal folds. Panting replaces normal breathing. The voice is weak, confused, and may slur (mimicking intoxication). Core temperature elevation causes dizziness — the speaker sounds disoriented. Volume drops because the body prioritizes cooling over communication. Speech rate slows to a crawl.

fatg_muscle_failure.name: Muscle Failure / Shaking Exhaustion
fatg_muscle_failure.acoustic_signature: The "quake." The body's muscles are in visible tremor — this transmits directly to the voice as a fast, involuntary vibrato. Jaw and neck muscles shake, destabilizing articulation. The speaker sounds like they're standing on a vibrating platform. Every exhale carries a tiny, involuntary whimper. Core instability makes the voice sound fundamentally unreliable.

fatg_adrenaline_crash.name: Post-Adrenaline Crash
fatg_adrenaline_crash.acoustic_signature: The "comedown." After a fight, accident, or emergency. Adrenaline withdrawal causes trembling, nausea, and emotional flooding. The voice is shaky and tearful even if the speaker isn't sad. Hands are shaking (audible if holding objects). Speech is rapid and repetitive as the brain replays the event. Sudden emotional outbursts (laughing, crying) without warning.

fatg_multi_day_deprivation.name: Multi-Day Sleep Deprivation (48h+)
fatg_multi_day_deprivation.acoustic_signature: The "unraveling." Beyond mere tiredness — the voice enters a hallucinatory, detached quality. Sentences begin rationally and derail into nonsense. The speaker may argue with things that aren't there. Micro-sleeps create sudden silences. Emotional regulation is destroyed — inappropriate laughter, sudden rage, paranoia. The voice sounds like a system failing.

fatg_post_crying_exhaustion.name: Post-Crying Exhaustion / Cried Out
fatg_post_crying_exhaustion.acoustic_signature: The "aftermath." The speaker has exhausted their tears. The voice is hoarse and raw from prolonged crying. Nasal congestion is severe, turning all nasal consonants oral. The eyes are swollen, affecting facial resonance. A fragile, emptied-out quality — the speaker is calm not because they feel better but because they have nothing left to expel.

_meta.concept: The type, intensity, and location of pain the speaker is currently experiencing. Pain hijacks the voice by triggering involuntary protective responses.
_meta.annotation_instruction: Listen for sudden gasps, guarded breathing, pitch spikes at onset of pain, reduced volume to minimize physical movement, and overall vocal tension.

pain_sharp_sudden.name: Sharp Sudden Pain (Cut/Stub/Sting)
pain_sharp_sudden.acoustic_signature: The "spike." An involuntary yelp or sharp intake of breath at the moment of injury. Immediately followed by guarded, tense speech with held breath. Pitch jumps dramatically at onset then settles into a strained baseline.

pain_burn_scald.name: Burn / Scald / Contact Pain
pain_burn_scald.acoustic_signature: The "hiss." Immediate sharp inhalation through clenched teeth ("sssss"). The voice becomes urgent and panicked. The speaker instinctively holds the affected area, reducing one arm's gestures.

pain_impact_blow.name: Impact / Blow to Body
pain_impact_blow.acoustic_signature: The "crumple." A sudden expulsion of air (grunt or "oof") as the diaphragm is impacted. Speech immediately after is breathless and shaky. If to the head, confusion and slurring follow.

pain_labor_contractions.name: Labor Contractions / Waves of Pain
pain_labor_contractions.acoustic_signature: The "crest." Pain arrives in predictable waves. Speech is normal between contractions, then rapidly deteriorates into moaning, grunting, or screaming at the peak, then gradually returns to coherence.

pain_chronic_back.name: Chronic Back/Joint Pain
pain_chronic_back.acoustic_signature: The "wince." A constant low-level tension in the voice. Periodic sharp intakes of breath when the speaker shifts position. Speech is weary and colored by long-suffering. Sighing is frequent.

pain_headache_migraine.name: Migraine / Severe Headache
pain_headache_migraine.acoustic_signature: The "whisper of necessity." The speaker minimizes all sound because noise exacerbates the pain. Volume is drastically reduced. Light sensitivity causes squinting which tightens the face. The voice sounds fragile.

pain_dental_toothache.name: Dental Pain / Toothache
pain_dental_toothache.acoustic_signature: The "guard." The speaker avoids opening the mouth fully. One-sided chewing of words. Cold air intake through the mouth causes wincing. Sibilants may be avoided because air flow over the tooth hurts.

pain_abdominal_cramp.name: Abdominal Cramp / Gut Pain
pain_abdominal_cramp.acoustic_signature: The "curl." The speaker doubles over, compressing the rib cage. Breathing becomes shallow and guarded. Voice is directed downward. Groaning undertone on sustained vowels.

pain_broken_bone.name: Broken Bone / Fracture
pain_broken_bone.acoustic_signature: The "shock." Initial scream followed by controlled, shaky breathing. The speaker becomes very still to avoid movement. Voice trembles. Adrenaline may temporarily mask the worst, creating an eerie calm before the pain fully registers.

pain_wound_bleeding.name: Open Wound / Bleeding
pain_wound_bleeding.acoustic_signature: The "fade." Progressive weakening as blood loss and shock set in. Voice starts panicked and energized, then gradually loses projection and coherence. Cold sweat and pallor audible as shivering onset.

pain_muscle_cramp_spasm.name: Muscle Spasm / Cramp
pain_muscle_cramp_spasm.acoustic_signature: The "seize." Sudden involuntary interruption of speech as the muscle locks. A sharp, strangled sound. The speaker may curse reflexively. Speech resumes once the spasm passes but remains tense and guarded.

pain_torture_extreme.name: Extreme Pain / Torture
pain_torture_extreme.acoustic_signature: The "break." Voice cycles between screaming, sobbing, and near-silence (shock). All social masking is destroyed. Raw, primal vocalizations replace language. Between episodes, the voice is destroyed--hoarse, breathy, and broken.
